external_seed.paper: The Quarter-Hour Effect: Periodic Algorithmic Trading and Return Predictability in Cryptocurrency Futures
external_seed.reused_idea: the first ten seconds of quarter-hour openings are a distinct periodic algorithmic-flow event
external_seed.not_reused: the paper's small standalone opening-return forecast, which is below taker costs

scenario.context: completed prior quarter ranges and existing regional liquidity objectives
scenario.parent_event: above-trailing-median notional during the first ten seconds of minute 00, 15, 30 or 45; direction is signed taker flow
scenario.continuation: OI count and value stable/rising, opening direction delivered in the completed perpetual return, spot flow and return, last-fifteen-second flow, and closing L1 pressure
scenario.reversal: OI falls, opening direction fails in completed price, spot and tail flow reverse, and closing L1 pressure flips
scenario.entry: completed opening minute after the state route; no extra late confirmation
scenario.invalidation: same opening-minute extreme for reversal or opening-minute range/open for continuation
scenario.target: unconsumed completed quarter or regional liquidity after full modeled costs; no fallback objective

arbitration: an already-open regional parent interaction has causal priority; quarter-hour events are considered only when no regional parent or pending state exists
